Local knowledge, since 2009

A well-made journey begins long before you arrive.

Behind every route there are decisions: how far to go, where to stay, who to work with and what deserves time. Xènia and Abdoul have spent years creating and coordinating journeys in Morocco, with a local operation built around real people and relationships.

For agencies, we are a team on the ground. For travellers, a starting point to shape the journey they want to make.

A way of travelling the country

It's not only about where you go.
But how you live it.

Southern Morocco · At nightfall

Morocco can be travelled in many ways. We prefer to do it with time to look, learn and connect.

Morocco is our territory

Erg Chigaga,
our roots.

Abdoul was born in the Sahara and lived there until he was seven, among the dunes, the stars and nomadic life. Today he owns his own camp in Erg Chigaga.

That is why Chigaga is not just another stop. It is a place that is part of his story and that he shares with the knowledge of someone who calls it home.
